description: Amending the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meetings held on 2025‑07­07 and 2025‑10‑13 to amend the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, including amendments for strengthening compliance, and monitoring of tax incentives, and institutional reorganization. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
